readOnlyRoutes.reason: Mastery Seasons read model exposes personalized Academy recommendations only after strict session, tenant principal binding, rate limiting and private no-store controls. 2026-08-13 (#109, audit finding F-9): the two locale reads shared one pooled client through Promise.all and are now awaited in order — pg 8 serialized them anyway. Read-only status, the reject-all-query-parameters rule and the tenant/principal resolution are unchanged. Updated for roadmap 7.1.3 (multi-tenant #20): this GET now passes its request to resolveTenantPrincipalContext, so a bound white-label host resolves to that tenant instead of falling through to the platform default. A host naming no bound domain asserts nothing and the route resolves exactly as before. 2026-08-14 (multi-tenant #20, section 3.3): after the tenant is resolved this GET now calls requireTenantProduct(tenantContext.tenantId, "academy"), refusing 403 product_not_entitled when the acting tenant was not provisioned with Academy and 503 when the entitlement cannot be read. platform_tenants.products[] had been carried and read by nothing, so a tenant without Academy was served this recommendation read exactly like one that bought it; the gate is the enforcement. Read-only status, the reject-all-query-parameters rule and every prior control are unchanged, so this entry is re-pinned rather than rewritten.
